rows.comment: the film’s comedic pacing is awkward at best
rows.verdict_le10: the film’s comedic pacing is awkward at best
rows.dek_lead: However dopey, Legally Blonde is remarkably mindful of Elle’s individualism, at least by Hollywood film standards. Still, the film’s comedic pacing is awkward at best. Luketic thinks broader and gaudier than Alexander Payne and Wes Anderson
